verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a commerce/POS platform with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, development store, or any other isolated environment that keeps testing away from production data. Shopify CLI scaffolding, POS UI extensions and Admin API access are developer building blocks, not a sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
